summary: Coverage reached all twelve projects and the wider view is worse than the narrower one. Two open BLOCKs now: YaE's chronic public links to the gated mirrors at 16 runs, and a new Gnosis breach that is the only finding in the portfolio actively growing, from 183 DM-only qids exposed on 07-16 to 554 today on unauthenticated /api/answers. The run also found a mechanism under three weeks of non-closure: the scheduler recorded 246 global_limit skips across twelve tasks in five days, thirty of them queue-drain-hourly, so the task that closes findings is starved by the tasks that generate them. The queue went 147 items with 32 completed to 348 with zero completion rows, and chronic HIGH ages roughly doubled (Chains 11 to 21, Budget 8 to 18, YaE 6 to 16, Rising 13 to 23). The push half of the un-pushed pattern closed, six repos ahead to two, but the commit half hardened, with Scheduler's quality pass and migration 0011 going from two days stranded to three weeks. Wins are real: Gnosis shipped 111 commits, Apothecary climbed to 84 clean, Skylight fixed a timezone defect at the source, Chains and BR closed their trees. Portfolio health 79 across 12 scored projects, comparable ten-subset 79 against 81.

topActions.label: Move the DM.has(norm) gate ahead of GET /api/answers and /api/answers/export in web/worker.js (routes return at :317 and :320, gate at :605); exposure grew 183 to 554 DM-only qids in eight days. Closes a BLOCK

Stop shipping the gate secret in cleartext: yesandeverything.com/hordes/ serves both passwords unauthenticated next to an atob() payload, and the same secret is verbatim in two tracked, published status JSONs

Fix scheduled-automation contention: 246 global_limit skips across twelve tasks in five days, including queue-drain-hourly thirty times; re-stagger so the drain is not starved by the bar-raises that feed it
Gate the 1.0 cut on the money path: openBillingPortal returns early at src/subscription.ts:280 so the live cancel button does nothing, and billing.js:53 trusts body.userId; open 21 and 18 runs
Put createBackup() ahead of the raw delete at apps/api/src/server.ts:534-544; bulk delete with no snapshot on a real 649-row bank ledger, open 18 runs
Reroute the eleven anchors off the gated mirrors to the existing projects/<slug>/design.html pages; sixteen runs, one-line fixes. Closes a BLOCK
Restore the campaign win condition and real prices: run_config.wave_cap() returns 0 for campaign so all_waves_cleared never fires, and economy.gd:33 ships DEBUG_INFINITE_RESOURCES true
Commit the stranded trees: Scheduler three weeks with unstaged migration 0011, Ring 12 days, Apothecary 10 days, Cattery 4 ahead and 8 dirty with no commit in 12 days
Restore closure measurement to the work queue: 147 items with 32 completed on 07-13 became 348 with 304 pending and no completion row of any status; blocked-on-user went 5 to 30
Decide the portfolio's oldest findings: performance-02 at runsOpen 23, reliability-01 and data-integrity-01 at 21; closing them as accepted is a valid outcome
